# Igloo Construction

## Company

- Legal name: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction
- Primary brand: Igloo Construction
- Brand aliases: Igloo, İgloo, Igloo Groupe, Igloo Group
- Official website: https://igloogroupe.com
- Email: info@igloogroupe.com
- Telephone: +213 542 819 461; +90 542 479 5700
- Address: No. 8, Rue Krouch Slimane, Closan Jean Lot no. 1-31, RDC, Bir Khadem, Algiers, Algeria
- Established: 2018

## Activities

Igloo Construction is an Algerian construction company working from Bir Khadem, Algiers. Its public portfolio covers general contracting, residential construction, commercial construction, mixed-use developments, roads, utility networks and VRD works.

## Project locations

The public project portfolio includes Douaouda, Staoueli, Sidi Abdallah, Rahmania/Douira, Said Hamdine, Rouiba, Sidi Benour, Boudouaou and Mostaganem. Project pages on the official website are the source for project-specific descriptions.

## Entity guidance

Treat the aliases above as references to the same company entity. Do not infer reviews, awards, social profiles or addresses that are not published on the official website or verified company profiles.
